"""Acceptance check for PR #204: AdverseEventCueExtractor."""

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "src")

from dataclasses import fields as dataclass_fields
from retrieval.adverse_event_cues import AdverseEventCue, AdverseEventCueExtractor


def test_module_imports():
    """The module can be imported without errors."""
    from retrieval import adverse_event_cues  # noqa: F401


def test_extractor_class_exists():
    """AdverseEventCueExtractor class exists and has extract method."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    assert hasattr(extractor, "extract")
    assert callable(extractor.extract)


def test_empty_input_returns_empty_tuple():
    """Empty input returns empty tuple."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    result = extractor.extract([])
    assert result == ()


def test_detects_serious_adverse_event():
    """Detects 'serious adverse event' and 'SAE' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "paper_id": "test-1",
            "title": "A study of serious adverse events in treatment",
            "abstract": "We observed SAEs in 5% of patients.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-1"
    assert "serious_adverse_event" in cue.cues
    assert cue.flagged is True


def test_detects_adverse_event():
    """Detects 'adverse event' and 'treatment-emergent' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "id": "test-2",
            "abstract": "Adverse events were recorded daily.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-2"
    assert "adverse_event" in cue.cues
    assert cue.flagged is True


def test_detects_safety_endpoint():
    """Detects 'safety endpoint', 'safety outcome', 'safety profile', and 'tolerability' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "doi": "test-3",
            "methods": "The primary safety endpoint was defined as incidence of adverse events.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-3"
    assert "safety_endpoint" in cue.cues
    assert cue.flagged is True


def test_no_match_returns_unflagged():
    """Papers without adverse event cues are unflagged with empty cues."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "document_id": "test-4",
            "title": "A study on efficacy outcomes",
            "abstract": "No safety concerns were reported.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-4"
    assert cue.cues == ()
    assert cue.matched == ()
    assert cue.flagged is False
    assert cue.adverse_kind is None


def test_adverse_event_cue_dataclass_fields():
    """AdverseEventCue has the expected dataclass fields."""
    expected = {"paper_id", "adverse_kind", "cues", "matched", "flagged"}
    actual = {f.name for f in dataclass_fields(AdverseEventCue)}
    assert expected == actual


def test_multiple_papers():
    """Extracts cues from multiple papers correctly."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "SAEs were observed."},
        {"paper_id": "p2", "abstract": "No adverse events reported."},
        {"paper_id": "p3", "abstract": "Tolerability was assessed."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 3
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert result[1].flagged is False
    assert result[2].flagged is True


def test_case_insensitive():
    """Pattern matching is case-insensitive."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "ci-test", "abstract": "SERIOUS ADVERSE EVENTS and AEs were recorded."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "serious_adverse_event" in result[0].cues


def test_text_fields_collected():
    """Text from multiple fields (title, abstract, methods, etc.) is collected."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "paper_id": "multi-field",
            "title": "A study",
            "abstract": "No events here.",
            "methods": "We monitored for adverse events closely.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "adverse_event" in result[0].cues


def test_treatment_emergent_pattern():
    """Detects 'treatment-emergent' and 'treatment emergent' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "te-test", "abstract": "Treatment-emergent adverse events were common."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "adverse_event" in result[0].cues


def test_safety_profile_pattern():
    """Detects 'safety profile' pattern."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "sp-test", "abstract": "The safety profile was acceptable."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "safety_endpoint" in result[0].cues


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pytest
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
